description: This Java class defines a Liquibase custom task for creating discontinue orders in the OpenMRS healthcare system. It interacts with the database to fetch discontinued orders and insert them into the 'orders' table with specific fields indicating discontinuation.

classes.name: CreateDiscontinueOrders
classes.description: A Liquibase custom task class that creates discontinue orders in the database by processing existing order data.

classes.name: CreateDiscontinueOrders.DiscontinuedOrder
classes.description: A private static inner class representing a discontinued order with relevant fields.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method invoked during the custom change execution, which retrieves discontinued orders and creates new discontinue orders in the database.

methods.name: createDiscontinueOrders
methods.description: Inserts a batch of discontinued orders into the database, handling transactions and batching.

methods.name: setIntOrNull
methods.description: Utility to set an integer parameter in PreparedStatement, or null if the value is null or zero.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles exceptions by rolling back the transaction and throwing a CustomChangeException.

methods.name: getDiscontinuedOrders
methods.description: Fetches existing discontinued orders from the database.

methods.name: getConfirmationMessage
methods.description: Returns a confirmation message after the task completes.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Setup method for the custom change; empty in this implementation.

methods.name: setFileOpener
methods.description: Sets the resource accessor; empty in this implementation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the database before executing; returns null, implying no validation errors.
